__HIDDENCAT__
This hidden maintenance category collects pages whose character infobox names a picture that the wiki does not have yet. Its subcategories sort the pages by the kind of picture they need: a character, a chest, or a summoned creature.

To fill a gap, upload a picture from the game under the exact file name that the infobox names. A page leaves the category once the file exists and the page is refreshed. The project also renders missing pictures from the game's 3D models and uploads them after a review, so a gap may close on its own. See [[Erenshor Wiki:Game Data#Images]].
